subject.title: [Feature]: Feature Request: Pre-send Message Validation for Feishu Group Chat

question: Should Feishu notification intent be expressed through typed outbound recipient IDs, or should the plugin heuristically warn or block based on arbitrary message text?
rationale: Current main intentionally keeps model-authored mention-like markup inert, and changing that boundary or adding a new configuration policy requires an explicit product choice coordinated with the broader bot-to-bot work.

options.title: Typed mention recipients
options.body: Expose explicit Feishu recipient identifiers through the plugin message surface and serialize them using the existing native mention path.

options.title: Heuristic plugin validation
options.body: Add Feishu-local warn or block modes only after defining intended-recipient metadata, accepted syntax, false-positive behavior, and interaction with existing bot-to-bot work.

options.title: Keep current scope
options.body: Continue automatic mention forwarding only when OpenClaw already has structured inbound mention targets and leave arbitrary text unchanged.

recommendation.title: Typed mention recipients
recommendation.body: Expose explicit Feishu recipient identifiers through the plugin message surface and serialize them using the existing native mention path.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current structured outbound mention behavior and its explicit safety rationale.
